sceneEvidence.assistance: Isolated order preparation and initial QA staging above a real metro. Actual descent, roof carry to a different station, exits, roof rolloff, platform parking and F handover followed with normal native controls. This is not a natural pickup or full-campaign proof.
observations: All four exact candidates visibly walk out of the actual open metro door in sequence onto the existing physical platform. Full bodies, feet and cloth remain readable in the late exit frames.

Player rolled laterally off the actual train roof, landed at14.25m, aligned parallel to the platform and stopped within the marked bay. No post-boarding staging, teleport or reset occurred in this final run.

All four are readable in fixed night and daylight captures. New lawyer crown has no beige fallback band; ordinary coarse dark-gray variation remains. Cream/red, white floral and pink companion clothing remains distinct.

Manual F produces open articulated hands, a complete physical carton, visible passing/caught states and completion. Wrists meet the carton underside consistently with the exact separately viewed palmar diagnostic; front-view carton occludes palm faces naturally.
After Next, all four remain on the platform in the same close view. Lawyer arms visibly return fully down to relaxed idle; carton is removed and no catch hold or disappearance remains.
limits: Desktop landscape touch-layout inspection, not physical-phone, FPS, thermal or battery evidence.
